launchpad_fees_accrued.meaning: some launchpad fees have accrued in the pair
launchpad_fees_accrued.checkpoint: before the malicious user's mint/swap call

time_elapsed.meaning: timeElapsed value in GTELaunchpadV2Pair._update() at the checked call
time_elapsed.checkpoint: before the malicious user's mint/swap call

credited_amount.meaning: amount credited to the malicious user by the mint/swap accounting
credited_amount.checkpoint: after the malicious user's mint/swap call

sent_amount.meaning: amount the malicious user actually sent to the contract
sent_amount.checkpoint: at the malicious user's mint/swap call

assumptions: The malicious user calls mint or swap on the pair (a_call_mint_or_swap).
The credited amount and sent amount are denominated in the same token unit.
No special authorization is required to call mint/swap, per report ambiguity.

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete amounts or units for the credited amount versus the amount actually sent; relation is kept symbolic.
Report does not establish exact prior reserve/balance values before the action.

limitations: Formalizes only v_credited_unspent_amount; other impacts (v_balance_exceeds_reserve, v_pair_drained) are out of scope for this plan.
The credited/sent amount relation is symbolic; no concrete numeric magnitudes are supplied by the report.
The correspondence between reserves and balances is captured only through the credited-vs-sent amount relation for this impact.
